summary: Frontend-only e2e test of modularized AdminPage.jsx (refactor 2094→1472 LOC, 3 lazy-loaded tab components). Logged in as admin@bidblitz.com, navigated to /admin/old (actual route for refactored AdminPage.jsx; /admin routes to AdminPanelFullPage), clicked all 19 tabs, exercised the 3 extracted tab components end-to-end. All 3 lazy-loaded tabs render via LazyErrorBoundary+Suspense without JS errors. 0 critical console errors (no LazyErrorBoundary-retry, no 'is not defined', no 'Cannot read properties of undefined').

issues: Tab label for 'loyalty' shows raw i18n key 'admin.loyalty' (untranslated) — missing translation string, not a blocker but visually unpolished.

action_items: Heads-up: /admin route in App.js (line 453-455) renders <AdminPanelFullPage/>, NOT the refactored AdminPage.jsx. The refactored AdminPage.jsx (with 3 new lazy tabs) is only reachable at /admin/old. Confirm this is intentional — the review request said 'navigate to /admin' but the refactored code lives at /admin/old. If users are expected to see the refactored version, the route should be swapped.
Add German translation for i18n key 'admin.loyalty' (currently rendered verbatim in tab bar).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPage.jsx is still 1472 LOC — further split recommended (extract Users, Merchants, Payouts, Transactions sub-tabs similar to the 3 done here) to get below 700 LOC guideline.
adminHelpers.jsx (58 LOC) correctly centralizes Skeleton/StatCard/adminApi/statusColors — good DRY.
LazyErrorBoundary + Suspense wrapping is consistent across all 3 new tabs — correct pattern.
The 3 new tab components receive 7-15 props each (prop drilling). Consider context or hook (useAdminAuctions, useAdminScooters, useAdminGutscheine) to reduce coupling.
load() function in AdminPage.jsx line 498-500 calls onNavigate('/admin/credits') inside a data-loading switch — side-effect navigation from data layer is unusual; works but mixes concerns.
test_credentials: admin@bidblitz.com / BidBlitz2026! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) — valid, login returns 200 + cookies.
seed_data_creation: None (no data mutations performed; only read + form-open).
context_for_next_testing_agent: AdminPage.jsx refactor target is route /admin/old — NOT /admin. App.js:469-472 routes /admin/old to <AdminPage>. The /admin route renders AdminPanelFullPage. For onboarding skip: localStorage.setItem('bidblitz_onboarded','1'). For auth, POST /api/auth/login with email+password; cookies (access_token, refresh_token) set automatically. Tab buttons have no data-testid — use text-content match on '[data-testid="admin-page"] > div:nth-child(2) button'. Clicking 'Kreditanträge' tab triggers onNavigate('/admin/credits') which leaves the page (existing side-effect in load()).
